selection: All main small cases; every medium instance/method/cohort at placement0; large first instance within cohort/encoding/method at placement0. Retain both saved control modes; deduplicate numerical solves by coefficients.

variants.pairs_only: alpha*h, U from rounded geometric distances

coefficient_convention: E=sum(h_i*x_i)+sum(i<j,J_ij*x_i*x_j); symmetric J stores full unordered-pair coefficients; constants dropped in all variants
quantum_caveat: Classical diagonal endpoint energy only; transverse drive amplitudes recorded, no time-evolution claim
